name: The Third Fleet
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I was once First Mate on the Wave Mistress, ship-of-the-line in the Kul Tiras Third Fleet.  The Doomed Fleet.  Doomed, for on its last voyage the fleet was attacked  by Red Dragons.  Dragons controlled by Orcs!

We didn't stand a chance against that dragonfire...and our fleet was burned and sunk off this here coast.  I'm the sole survivor of those poor vessels...

...Oh, my head hammers and pounds!  I'll need a fresh drink if I'm to get a handle on this hangover and continue my tale.
narrative.objectives: Buy First Mate Fitzsimmons a Flagon of Mead.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah! That hits the spot, and loosens the tongue. Thanks, mate!
narrative.requestItemsText: Oh, I'm so very thirsty! Won't you buy a drink for this poor, pathetic fool?
